about: Literals that look like a profile, model, provider, board, host or channel name but are not stack data, read by the name checks in the selftests (D47, K12: bin/hardcode-lint-selftest.sh). own_names: the stack's own names (data folder, tool and marker names), removed in every file before counting. allow: exact text removed before counting in one file (where the word comes from, and the phase that may remove it). baseline: at most `count` whole-word uses of `literal` in `file`, each with the phase that removes it; one more use, or a new literal, fails the suite. watch: literals no data file holds yet (other channels, Claude model names), counted like the data literals (B2V-05).

own_names.why: the stack's data folder, where the contract data lives; not the project slug of the same name
the SOUL region marker, the stack's name, not the project slug
the apply tool's own file name (bin/stella-apply.py), not the project slug
the recovery script's file name in docs/

allow.why: the argument name of Hermes's kanban_request_review tool (tools/kanban_tools.py), not a profile name
